explanation.headline: Piperacillin and tazobactam is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21; Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC posted a discontinuation on 2026-01-20

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list shows piperacillin and tazobactam is not listed as of 2026-10-21.
Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC posted a discontinuation for piperacillin and tazobactam injection on 2026-01-20.
Corvale East holds 261 vials of the 2 g + 0.25 g presentation with 17.9 days on hand at 14.6 vials per day.
Corvale General holds 376 vials of the same presentation with 23.6 days on hand at 16 vials per day.
For the 36 g/180 mL + 4.5 g/180 mL presentation, Corvale East has 24.8 days on hand, Corvale General has 25.1 days, and Corvale Lakeside has 18.1 days.
The rule-based check finds no FDA shortage posting before a registered plant action, so the buyer should verify current supplier allocations and consider alternate manufacturers.
Apotex Corp. is the top-ranked alternate manufacturer option, though its label names no plant we could place.
